name: veritae-workflow
description: AI-native workflow powering Veritae — an iOS + Java Spring app — published as a byproduct so other iOS+Spring teams can fork it. Role-based agents hand off via shared artifacts (PRD → design → OpenAPI → code → review).

plugins.name: veritae-workflow
plugins.description: 10 role-based subagents (planner, api-architect, designer, ios-dev, spring-dev, qa, convention-checker, + 3 specialized reviewers) driving development of Veritae, an iOS + Spring app. Per-role model selection (Opus for planning/design/qa/review, Sonnet for coding, Haiku for fast lint/convention pre-pass), ADR + lessons-learned history conventions built in.
